seg.notes: Four reportable segments: Aggregates, Asphalt, Concrete, Calcium (Calcium still reported separately, not folded in). Aggregates revenues include freight & delivery and service revenues; the only intersegment elimination published is 'Aggregates intersegment sales'. Freight & delivery revenues and other revenues are the deductions in the freight-adjusted revenue reconciliation (segment level, incl. intersegment freight). Calcium volume/price no longer published (from Q2-23 release). Volumes published in millions to 1 dp. Asphalt and concrete prices exclude service revenues (footnote 5). Texas ready-mix concrete operations divested in Q4-23 (approx. 4m cubic yards in 2023 per outlook).

is.notes: Effective tax rate from continuing operations 31.3%. Discontinued operations = former Chemicals business (legal/environmental, incl. Lower Passaic River). Quarterly DPS from 10-Q XBRL (CommonStockDividendsPerShareCashPaid, $0.43 per quarter; Vulcan declares and pays in the same quarter); Q4 = FY - 9M from 10-K annual $1.72. Release shows costs as negatives from 2023; stored positive.

ebitda_bridge_lines: (Gain) loss on sale of real estate and businesses, net
eps_bridge_lines: Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above, net of tax
Adjusted diluted EPS attributable to Vulcan from continuing operations
ebitda_build_lines: Income tax expense, including discontinued operations
ngaap.notes: New basis from Q2-23: EBITDA = NI attributable to Vulcan + income tax expense INCLUDING discontinued operations + interest + DDA&A; pre-tax loss on discontinued operations is an adjustment in the Adjusted EBITDA bridge (adj_items.disc_ops). Bridge line 'Acquisition related charges' (renamed from 'Business development'); restructuring no longer a separate line. Adjusted EPS bridge starts at diluted EPS net earnings; eps_items_after_tax_ps includes the discontinued-operations per-share amount (included in 'Items included in Adjusted EBITDA above, net of tax') so that start + items + discrete = adjusted. 'Acquisition financing interest costs' (0.00 where shown) counted in items. Discrete tax = Calica NOL carryforward valuation allowance. ROIC = TTM Adjusted EBITDA / 5-quarter average invested capital, in percent.
